title: Refund to the Guest When the Host Cancels a Stay
content:
# Refund when the host cancels

**Clause.** When the host cancels a confirmed reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the guest is refunded the policy's host-cancellation refund percentage of every amount collected on the stay — nightly, cleaning, pet and extra-guest fees, guest service fee and occupancy tax — whatever the stay's cancellation policy, rate type, payment plan or the guest's service-fee refund history, and installments not yet collected are cancelled. Each component is posted with the host-cancellation reason and at the stage before payout release, because a host can cancel only before check-in and earnings are released only after check-in. A host-cancellation refund for the same stay and the same charge component is issued only once; whether one exists is read from the host-cancellation refund entries for that component on the stay's ledger. These refunds never count toward the guest service fee refund cap. The host-side consequences of the cancellation (penalty, calendar block, standing) are governed by the Host Accounts and Listings rules.

## Component by component

| Component collected | Refunded | Reason | Payout stage | Funded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nightly | the policy's host-cancellation percentage of the amount collected | host cancellation | before payout release | host |
| Cleaning fee | same | host cancellation | before payout release | host |
| Pet fee | same | host cancellation | before payout release | host |
| Extra-guest fee | same | host cancellation | before payout release | host |
| Guest service fee | same | host cancellation | before payout release | platform |
| Occupancy tax | same | host cancellation | before payout release | platform |

Installments not yet collected are cancelled and never collected.

## What does not change the result

The stay's cancellation policy, a non-refundable rate, a pay-part-now or monthly plan, and earlier guest service fee refunds on the guest's other stays make no difference to a host-cancellation refund.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures, 100.00% refund level)

On a hypothetical pay-part-now stay where installment 1 collected 400.00 of nightly price and 56.80 of guest service fee and installment 2 had not yet been collected, a host cancellation refunds 400.00 of nightly price (funded by the host) and 56.80 of guest service fee (funded by the platform), and installment 2 is cancelled.
